import csv
tsid = "c1021e2f-bb67-5120-895b-3a425fb6ff0a"
rows = []
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    r = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in r:
        if row["timeseries_id"] == tsid and row["timestamp"].startswith("2018-04-16"):
            rows.append((row["timestamp"], float(row["value"])))
rows.sort()
print(len(rows))
for t,v in rows:
    print(t, v)
maxv = max(v for _,v in rows)
print("max", maxv)
print("all <=23:", maxv <= 23)
